help-human-keyboard: One sentence per line. Each is cleaned up to lowercase letters and single spaces, then must be 20 to 60 characters.
help-identity-crisis: One person or character per line, 2 to 60 characters. Add other names a guess may use after a bar: Ada Lovelace | Lovelace.
help-wit-war: One prompt per line, 8 to 120 characters. Players write funny answers to them.
line-alias-too-long: Line {{line}} has an alias over {{limit}} characters.

line-empty-after-normalising: Line {{line}} has no letters once it is cleaned up.
line-too-long: Line {{line}} is too long: at most {{limit}} characters.
line-too-short: Line {{line}} is too short: at least {{limit}} characters.
